quotes.chinese: 上帝，请赐我宁静，去接受我不能改变的一切；赐我勇气，去改变我能改变的一切；并赐我智慧，去分辨两者的不同。
quotes.english: God, give me grace to accept with serenity the things that cannot be changed, courage to change the things which should be changed, and the wisdom to distinguish the one from the other.
quotes.author: 雷茵霍尔德·尼布尔

quotes.chinese: 这也会过去。
quotes.english: This too shall pass.
quotes.author: 波斯谚语

quotes.chinese: 折磨我们的往往是想象，而非事实。
quotes.english: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: 塞涅卡

quotes.chinese: 并非所有你能面对的事都能被改变，但任何事在改变之前都必须先被面对。
quotes.english: Not everything that is faced can be changed. But nothing can be changed until it is faced.
quotes.author: 詹姆斯·鲍德温

quotes.chinese: 伤口是光进入你内心的地方。
quotes.english: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
quotes.author: 鲁米

quotes.chinese: 有人说'时间治愈一切伤口'。我不同意。伤口还在。时间长了，理智为了保护自己，用疤痕组织把它们盖住，疼痛减轻了，但它从未消失。
quotes.english: It has been said, 'time heals all wounds.' I do not agree. The wounds remain. In time, the mind, protecting its sanity, covers them with scar tissue and the pain lessens. But it is never gone.
quotes.author: 罗丝·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪

quotes.chinese: 悲伤乘着时间的翅膀飞走。
quotes.english: Sadness flies away on the wings of time.
quotes.author: 让·德·拉封丹

quotes.chinese: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。
quotes.english: Come to me, all you who are struggling hard and carrying heavy loads, and I will give you rest.
quotes.author: 耶稣基督

quotes.chinese: 所有的治愈，首先是心灵的治愈。
quotes.english: All healing is first a healing of the heart.
quotes.author: 卡尔·汤森德

quotes.chinese: 尽管世界充满苦难，但也充满了克服苦难的力量。
quotes.english: Although the world is full of suffering, it is also full of the overcoming of it.
quotes.author: 海伦·凯勒

quotes.chinese: 愈合需要勇气，我们都有勇气，即使需要挖掘才能找到它。
quotes.english: Healing takes courage, and we all have courage, even if we have to dig a little to find it.
quotes.author: 托莉·阿莫斯

quotes.chinese: 接纳就像一剂药膏，治愈你自我造成的伤口。
quotes.english: Acceptance is like a salve that heals your self-inflicted wounds.
quotes.author: 唐纳德·奥尔特曼

quotes.chinese: 宽恕过去。它已经结束了。从中学习，然后放手。
quotes.english: Forgive the past. It is over. Learn from it and let go.
quotes.author: 布莱恩·魏斯

quotes.chinese: 理解是接纳的第一步，只有接纳才能有康复。
quotes.english: Understanding is the first step to acceptance, and only with acceptance can there be recovery.
quotes.author: J·K·罗琳
quotes.source_en: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.chinese: 我们的悲伤和伤口只有当我们以慈悲之心触碰它们时才能愈合。
quotes.english: Our sorrows and wounds are healed only when we touch them with compassion.
quotes.author: 佛陀

quotes.chinese: 治愈并不意味着回到以前的样子，而是让现在的一切带领我们更接近上帝。
quotes.english: Healing does not mean going back to the way things were before, but rather allowing what is now to move us closer to God.
quotes.author: 拉姆·达斯

quotes.chinese: 灵魂通过与孩子在一起而得到治愈。
quotes.english: The soul is healed by being with children.
quotes.author: 费奥多尔·陀思妥耶夫斯基

quotes.chinese: 希望和耐心是每个人的救命药。灾难临头时，它们是最可靠的依赖，最柔软的倚垫。
quotes.english: Hope and patience are everyone's remedy. When misfortunes occur, they are the best reliance, the softest cushion.
quotes.author: R·伯顿

quotes.chinese: 愈合是时间的问题，但有时也是机遇的问题。
quotes.english: Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity.
quotes.author: 希波克拉底

quotes.chinese: 我们每个人在治愈这个世界方面都有独特的作用。
quotes.english: Each of us has a unique part to play in the healing of the world.
quotes.author: 玛丽安·威廉森

quotes.chinese: 治愈可能与其说是变得更好，不如说是放下一切不属于你的东西——所有的期望、所有的信念——成为真正的你。
quotes.english: Healing may not be so much about getting better, as about letting go of everything that isn't you – all of the expectations, all of the beliefs – and becoming who you are.
quotes.author: 雷切尔·娜奥米·雷门

quotes.chinese: 我在这里。我爱你。我不在乎你是否需要整夜哭泣，我会陪着你。
quotes.english: I'm here. I love you. I don't care if you need to stay up crying all night long, I will stay with you.
quotes.author: 伊丽莎白·吉尔伯特

quotes.chinese: 宽恕的实践是我们对治愈世界最重要的贡献。
quotes.english: The practice of forgiveness is our most important contribution to the healing of the world.
quotes.author: 玛丽安·威廉森

quotes.chinese: 诗治愈理性造成的伤口。
quotes.english: Poetry heals the wounds inflicted by reason.
quotes.author: 诺瓦利斯

quotes.chinese: 所有的伤口都是伤疤，所有的伤疤都教会我们一些东西。
quotes.english: All wounds are scars, and all scars teach us something.
quotes.author: 科马克·麦卡锡

quotes.chinese: 治愈的愿望一直是健康的一半。
quotes.english: The wish for healing has always been half of health.
quotes.author: 塞涅卡

quotes.chinese: 生命不是要去解决的问题，而是要去体验的奥秘。
quotes.english: Life is not a problem to be solved, but a mystery to be experienced.
quotes.author: 史蒂芬·吉利根
quotes.source_en: The Courage to Love and Live

quotes.chinese: 我们来到这个世界，是为了从彼此分离的幻象中醒来。
quotes.english: We are here to awaken from the illusion of our separateness.
quotes.author: 一行禅师

quotes.chinese: 治愈是爱的另一种形式。
quotes.english: Healing is another form of love.
quotes.author: 保罗·科埃略

quotes.chinese: 时间并不能治愈所有伤口，但它教会我们如何与伤疤共存。
quotes.english: Time does not heal all wounds, but it teaches us how to live with the scars.
quotes.author: 卡桑德拉·克莱尔

quotes.chinese: 心灵一旦破碎，就再也无法完全修复，但它可以变得更强大。
quotes.english: Once the heart is broken, it can never be fully repaired, but it can become stronger.
quotes.author: 尼古拉斯·斯帕克斯

quotes.chinese: 你的痛苦很重要，你的故事很重要，你的治愈很重要。
quotes.english: Your pain matters, your story matters, your healing matters.
quotes.author: 布莱恩妮·韦斯特

quotes.chinese: 有时候，治愈就是选择在暴风雨中保持平静。
quotes.english: Sometimes healing is choosing to be still in the midst of the storm.
quotes.author: 梅洛迪·贝蒂

quotes.chinese: 接纳不是屈服，而是认识到事情本来的样子。
quotes.english: Acceptance is not resignation, but recognition of things as they are.
quotes.author: 塔拉·布拉克

quotes.chinese: 我们的伤口往往是我们最好和最美丽部分的入口。
quotes.english: Our wounds are often the openings into the best and most beautiful part of us.
quotes.author: 大卫·里乔

quotes.chinese: 接纳当下的自己，是通往平静的第一步。
quotes.english: Accepting yourself as you are in this moment is the first step toward peace.
quotes.author: 埃克哈特·托勒

quotes.chinese: 你无法阻止悲伤之鸟飞过你的头顶，但你可以阻止它们在你的头发里筑巢。
quotes.english: You cannot prevent the birds of sorrow from flying over your head, but you can prevent them from building nests in your hair.
quotes.author: 中国谚语

quotes.chinese: 最深的伤口往往产生最亮的光。
quotes.english: The deepest wounds often produce the brightest light.
quotes.author: 大卫·威尔科克

quotes.chinese: 治愈不是抹去过去，而是把过去整合进一个更完整的自己。
quotes.english: Healing is not about erasing the past, but integrating it into a more complete self.
quotes.author: 约翰·布雷萧
quotes.source_en: Healing the Shame That Binds You

quotes.chinese: 你的存在本身就是一种安慰。
quotes.english: Your presence alone is a comfort.
quotes.author: 亨利·努文

quotes.chinese: 有时候，最有治愈力的东西就是知道有人真的听见了你。
quotes.english: Sometimes the most healing thing is knowing that someone truly heard you.
quotes.author: 布伦妮·布朗

quotes.chinese: 感恩能把我们所拥有的变成足够，甚至更多。
quotes.english: Gratitude turns what we have into enough, and more.
quotes.author: 梅洛迪·贝蒂

quotes.chinese: 悲伤不是需要治愈的疾病，而是需要经历的情感。
quotes.english: Grief is not an illness to be cured, but an emotion to be experienced.
quotes.author: 伊丽莎白·库伯勒-罗斯

quotes.chinese: 治愈是在破碎中找到完整。
quotes.english: Healing is finding wholeness in brokenness.
quotes.author: 帕克·帕尔默

quotes.chinese: 你的心知道出路。信任它。
quotes.english: Your heart knows the way out. Trust it.
quotes.author: 鲁米

quotes.chinese: 有时治愈就是简单地允许自己感受你所感受的一切。
quotes.english: Sometimes healing is simply allowing yourself to feel everything you feel.
quotes.author: 朱迪丝·赫尔曼

quotes.chinese: 接纳是改变的起点。
quotes.english: Acceptance is the starting point of change.
quotes.author: 卡尔·罗杰斯

quotes.chinese: 没有一种痛苦是白受的。每一次苦难都在塑造你。
quotes.english: No pain is wasted. Every suffering shapes you.
quotes.author: C·S·刘易斯

quotes.chinese: 你的灵魂需要温柔的对待，就像对待一个受伤的孩子。
quotes.english: Your soul needs to be treated gently, like a wounded child.
quotes.author: 哈里特·比彻·斯托

quotes.chinese: 力量不是来自你能做什么，而是来自你克服了什么。
quotes.english: Strength does not come from what you can do, but from what you have overcome.
quotes.author: 海伦·凯勒

quotes.chinese: 万物皆有裂痕，那是光照进来的地方。
quotes.english: Everything has cracks, that's how the light gets in.
quotes.author: 莱昂纳德·科恩

quotes.chinese: 成长往往始于不适。治愈也是如此。
quotes.english: Growth often begins with discomfort. So does healing.
quotes.author: 哈里特·勒纳

quotes.chinese: 接纳不意味着赞同，只是承认事实如此。
quotes.english: Acceptance doesn't mean approval, just acknowledging that it is.
quotes.author: 艾米·莫林
quotes.source_en: 13 Things Mentally Strong People Don't Do

quotes.chinese: 你的心可以破碎，但仍然跳动着爱。
quotes.english: Your heart can be broken and still beat with love.
quotes.author: 安妮·拉莫特

quotes.chinese: 不要催促愈合。让它以自己的节奏到来。
quotes.english: Don't rush healing. Let it come at its own pace.
quotes.author: 苏珊·桑塔格

quotes.chinese: 最温柔的手往往是经历过最粗糙岁月的手。
quotes.english: The gentlest hands are often those that have lived through the roughest years.
quotes.author: 玛雅·安杰卢
quotes.source_en: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings

quotes.chinese: 每一次心碎都是成长的邀请。
quotes.english: Every heartbreak is an invitation to grow.
quotes.author: 奥普拉·温弗瑞

quotes.chinese: 痛苦是暂时的，但从中获得的智慧是永恒的。
quotes.english: Pain is temporary, but the wisdom gained from it is eternal.
quotes.author: 纳尔逊·曼德拉

quotes.chinese: 你的过去不能定义你，它只是为你现在的选择提供背景。
quotes.english: Your past does not define you, it only provides context for your present choices.
quotes.author: 米歇尔·奥巴马

quotes.chinese: 接纳你的故事，是书写新篇章的前提。
quotes.english: Accepting your story is the prerequisite for writing a new chapter.
quotes.author: 鲁皮·考尔

quotes.chinese: 伤口教会我们如何真正地活着。
quotes.english: Wounds teach us how to truly live.
quotes.author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗

quotes.chinese: 治愈不是忘记，而是重新记忆，以不同的方式记住。
quotes.english: Healing is not forgetting, but remembering differently.
quotes.author: 米歇尔·勒纳

quotes.chinese: 你需要先感受伤痛，才能开始愈合。
quotes.english: You need to feel the wound before you can begin to heal.
quotes.author: 玛丽·奥利弗

quotes.chinese: 接纳当下的自己，是通往自由的唯一道路。
quotes.english: Accepting yourself as you are is the only path to freedom.
quotes.author: 阿玛斯

quotes.chinese: 你的存在本身就是奇迹，不需要任何证明。
quotes.english: Your existence is a miracle in itself, needing no proof.
quotes.author: 爱因斯坦

quotes.chinese: 有时，最勇敢的事就是承认自己需要帮助。
quotes.english: Sometimes the bravest thing is admitting you need help.
quotes.author: 玛丽斯卡·哈吉塔伊

quotes.chinese: 不要让过去的痛苦偷走现在的快乐。
quotes.english: Don't let past pain steal present joy.
quotes.author: 保罗·科埃略

quotes.chinese: 每一种结束都是一个新的开始。
quotes.english: Every ending is a new beginning.
quotes.author: 普罗佩提乌斯

quotes.chinese: 最深的井往往有最甘甜的水。最深的痛苦往往带来最深的智慧。
quotes.english: The deepest wells often have the sweetest water. The deepest pain often brings the deepest wisdom.
quotes.author: 西奥多·罗斯福

quotes.chinese: 接纳不是放弃，而是选择和平。
quotes.english: Acceptance is not giving up, but choosing peace.
quotes.author: 达尔赖·拉姆

quotes.chinese: 你的伤疤是你最深刻教训的证明。
quotes.english: Your scars are proof of your deepest lessons.
quotes.author: 朱迪·布鲁姆
quotes.source_en: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret

quotes.chinese: 治愈是一场旅程，不是终点。
quotes.english: Healing is a journey, not a destination.
quotes.author: 安娜·昆德兰

quotes.chinese: 每一次眼泪都是一次净化。
quotes.english: Every tear is a purification.
quotes.author: 希拉里·克林顿

quotes.chinese: 你的心比你想象的更坚韧。
quotes.english: Your heart is stronger than you think.
quotes.author: 克里斯托弗·罗宾

quotes.chinese: 接纳是自由的开端。
quotes.english: Acceptance is the beginning of freedom.
quotes.author: 拜伦·凯蒂

quotes.chinese: 有时候，最好的疗愈方式就是安静地坐着，什么都不做。
quotes.english: Sometimes the best healing is sitting quietly and doing nothing.
quotes.author: 帕特里夏·埃文斯

quotes.chinese: 你的痛苦是独特的，但你不是孤独的。
quotes.english: Your pain is unique, but you are not alone.
quotes.author: 布伦妮·布朗

quotes.chinese: 治愈就是用爱覆盖恐惧的过程。
quotes.english: Healing is the process of covering fear with love.
quotes.author: 黛比·福特

quotes.chinese: 你的故事还没有结束。最好的章节还在后面。
quotes.english: Your story is not over. The best chapters are yet to come.
quotes.author: 艾米·珀迪

quotes.chinese: 接纳今天的不完美，是走向明天更好的第一步。
quotes.english: Accepting today's imperfection is the first step toward a better tomorrow.
quotes.author: 拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生

quotes.chinese: 恐惧使你成为囚徒，希望使你获得自由。
quotes.english: Fear makes you a prisoner, hope makes you free.
quotes.author: 弗兰克·德兰尼

quotes.chinese: 你的心灵是一个花园。你种什么，它就长什么。
quotes.english: Your mind is a garden. Whatever you plant, it grows.
quotes.author: 弗朗西斯·培根

quotes.chinese: 伤口使空气进入灵魂。
quotes.english: Wounds let the air into the soul.
quotes.author: 安妮·拉莫特

quotes.chinese: 接纳你的局限性，你的力量就在其中。
quotes.english: Accept your limitations, your strength lies within them.
quotes.author: 圣奥古斯丁

quotes.chinese: 治愈就像潮水，有来有退，但最终会上岸。
quotes.english: Healing is like the tide, it comes and goes, but eventually it reaches the shore.
quotes.author: 琼·狄第恩

quotes.chinese: 你的悲伤有你自己的形状，你的喜悦也有。
quotes.english: Your grief has its own shape, and so does your joy.
quotes.author: 玛丽·奥利弗

quotes.chinese: 不要害怕你的脆弱。那是你最真实的部分。
quotes.english: Don't be afraid of your vulnerability. It's your most authentic part.
quotes.author: 布伦妮·布朗

quotes.chinese: 愈合需要时间，而时间是一种仁慈。
quotes.english: Healing takes time, and time is a kindness.
quotes.author: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德

quotes.chinese: 接纳过去，但不被它定义。
quotes.english: Accept the past, but don't be defined by it.
quotes.author: 纳丁·戈迪默

quotes.chinese: 每一次呼吸都是一次新的开始。
quotes.english: Every breath is a new beginning.
quotes.author: 一行禅师

quotes.chinese: 你的伤口是你的向导，不是你的敌人。
quotes.english: Your wounds are your guides, not your enemies.
quotes.author: 玛丽安·威廉森

quotes.chinese: 治愈是学习如何与不可改变之事共处。
quotes.english: Healing is learning how to live with what cannot be changed.
quotes.author: 伊丽莎白·库伯勒-罗斯

quotes.chinese: 你的存在就是足够。你不需要成为别的什么。
quotes.english: Your being is enough. You don't need to be anything else.
quotes.author: 奥修

quotes.chinese: 痛苦是变化的信号。倾听它。
quotes.english: Pain is a signal for change. Listen to it.
quotes.author: 彼得·莱文

quotes.chinese: 接纳自己的不完美，是爱自己的开始。
quotes.english: Accepting your imperfections is the beginning of loving yourself.
quotes.author: 卡尔·荣格
quotes.source_en: The Collected Works of C.G. Jung

quotes.chinese: 每一片乌云都有一线希望。
quotes.english: Every cloud has a silver lining.
quotes.author: 约翰·弥尔顿

quotes.chinese: 你的灵魂需要休息，就像身体需要睡眠一样。
quotes.english: Your soul needs rest, just as your body needs sleep.
quotes.author: 托马斯·默顿

quotes.chinese: 接纳是力量，不是软弱。
quotes.english: Acceptance is strength, not weakness.
quotes.author: 韦恩·戴尔

quotes.chinese: 治愈是灵魂重新学习如何歌唱的过程。
quotes.english: Healing is the soul learning to sing again.
quotes.author: 克里斯汀·伊万诺娃

quotes.chinese: 你曾经破碎过，但你正在变成一幅马赛克——比原来的更美丽。
quotes.english: You have been broken, but you are becoming a mosaic — more beautiful than the original.
quotes.author: 阿南达·克里斯南
